0022600198.text: The Timberwolves (7-3, 3-1 at home, on a three-game win streak) host the Utah Jazz (1-8, on a seven-game losing streak) in Minnesota's 11th game of the season, with Minnesota 2nd in the Northwest, 1 game back, and Utah 5th in the Northwest, 6.5 games back. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (out, knee surgery; 33.3 points in 33.7 minutes per game this season) and Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery), while Joan Beringer is day-to-day with a fracture and a game-time decision, and Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (out, knee) and Jusuf Nurkic (out, foot strain), with Lauri Markkanen day-to-day with a wrist sprain and a game-time decision. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, but the Timberwolves won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 147-111 win in Minneapolis on March 18, 2026.
